name: atelier
description: The operating model for working with Claude as a teammate: the apex honesty doctrine; six skills (session onramp, the peer-review lifecycle, queue-run orchestration, repo-scaffolding to the house standard, fleet-sweep health runs and review-drain budget runs); and four commands (a hand-run scan with four of the floor's scanners — secret / leak / licence / link — the pre-commit hook installer, worktree and fleet-pin) — as an installable bundle. A named worked example; to adopt it you become the principal.
